chunks: This is certainly what you had denied.

key_terms.تَمْتَرُونَ: to doubt, to be in doubt, to deny

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says 'This is what you had denied'?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ad-Dukhan, this verse serves as a direct rebuke to the Quraysh, who had mocked the Prophet's warnings of divine punishment. It highlights the inevitability of the 'Day of Doubt' (Yawm al-Shakk), where their previous skepticism will be replaced by undeniable certainty, a theme central to Shia exegetical discussions on the transition from potentiality to actuality in divine retribution.
